'''''Zuppa del canavese''''' is an [[Italian cuisine|Italian]] baked dish from the [[Canavese]] region of [[Piedmont]]. It consists of layers of sliced bread baked with cabbage, cheese, and broth.<ref>[https://www.cucchiaio.it/ricetta/ricetta-zuppa-canavese/ Recipe from Cucchiaio d'Argento (In Italian)]</ref><ref>{{cite book|author=Mrs. W.
